s1.syndrome_frame: Acute chest pain with pleuritic and intermittent characteristics, associated with diaphoresis and elevated troponin levels, in a young adult with recent onset of systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain
No family history of cardiovascular disease
ECG showed sinus rhythm with benign early repolarization
Negative serum viral and autoantibody screens

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute chest pain with pleuritic and intermittent characteristics, associated with diaphoresis and elevated troponin levels, in a young adult with recent onset of systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Pleuritic pain worsened by sitting forward
Extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
key_facts: 2-day history of intermittent, sharp, central chest pain
No family history of cardiovascular disease
ECG showed sinus rhythm with benign early repolarization
Negative serum viral and autoantibody screens

differentials: Marfan syndrome with aortic root dilatation
Mitral valve prolapse with mitral annular disjunction
per_call: Marfan syndrome with aortic root dilatation
Mitral valve prolapse with mitral annular disjunction

shortlist.label: Myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated troponin levels, recent onset of systemic inflammation, and evidence of myocardial edema on CMR

shortlist.label: Acute coronary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated troponin levels, chest pain with diaphoresis, and evidence of systolic dysfunction on echocardiography

shortlist.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent diagnosis of ulcerative colitis and evidence of myocardial inflammation on CMR

shortlist.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of patchy late gadolinium enhancement on CMR, suggestive of myocardial inflammation

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated C-reactive protein, evidence of myocardial edema on CMR, and potential for eosinophilic involvement in the context of ulcerative colitis

raw.rationale: Elevated troponin, extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement, and myocardial edema on CMR suggest myocardial inflammation rather than coronary artery disease
raw.anchor_refutation: The patient's young age, absence of family history of cardiovascular disease, and lack of typical angina symptoms make acute coronary syndrome less likely; furthermore, CMR findings are more consistent with myocarditis

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: Atypical pain, young age, and CMR findings not consistent with coronary artery disease

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis-associated myocarditis
rejected.why: While the patient has ulcerative colitis, this specific diagnosis is too narrow without more direct evidence linking the colitis to myocarditis

rejected.label: Cardiac sarcoidosis
rejected.why: No evidence of sarcoidosis provided in the vignette

rejected.label: Eosinophilic myocarditis
rejected.why: No evidence of eosinophilia provided in the vignette
